title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาในบารังไกย์ Taclobo, เมือง Dumaguete, จังหวัด Negros Oriental ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Taclobo

text.en: There shall be established a high school in the Barangay of Taclobo, City of Dumaguete, Province of Negros Oriental, to be known as the Taclobo High School.
The Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
